realtime_protection_enabled.title: Real-Time Protection Enabled
realtime_protection_enabled.description: Indicates whether the antimalware engine's real-time on-access scanning and monitoring is actively enabled and running on the endpoint.

signature_db_age_hours.title: Signature Database Age (Hours)
signature_db_age_hours.description: The age of the currently deployed signature database in hours since it was last successfully updated.

heuristic_engine_enabled.title: Heuristic Engine Enabled
heuristic_engine_enabled.description: Indicates whether the heuristic analysis engine is actively enabled in the antimalware solution for detecting unknown and suspicious code patterns.

behavioral_monitoring_enabled.title: Behavioral Monitoring Enabled
behavioral_monitoring_enabled.description: Indicates whether real-time behavioral analysis (runtime monitoring of process behavior, memory, and API calls) is active on endpoints.

detection_sensitivity_level.title: Detection Sensitivity Level
detection_sensitivity_level.description: The configured sensitivity level of heuristic and behavioral detection engines, balancing false negatives against false positives.

real_time_scanning_enabled.title: Real-Time On-Access Scanning Enabled
real_time_scanning_enabled.description: Indicates whether the antimalware engine is actively scanning files and processes at the point of access or execution.

antimalware_service_state.title: Antimalware Service Running State
antimalware_service_state.description: The operational state of the underlying antimalware service or daemon that enforces real-time scanning.

signature_definitions_age_days.title: Signature Definitions Age (Days)
signature_definitions_age_days.description: Number of days since the antimalware signature definitions were last successfully updated.

automatic_quarantine_enabled.title: Automatic Quarantine Enabled
automatic_quarantine_enabled.description: Indicates whether the antimalware solution is configured to automatically isolate detected threats into a secured quarantine store without requiring manual approval.

remediation_mode.title: Remediation Mode
remediation_mode.description: The configured remediation mode determining how the endpoint protection solution responds to confirmed threats.

scheduled_scan_enabled.title: Scheduled Scan Enabled
scheduled_scan_enabled.description: Whether periodic/scheduled full or targeted malware scans are configured and active on the endpoint.

scan_frequency_days.title: Scan Frequency (Days)
scan_frequency_days.description: How often a full or comprehensive scan is scheduled to run, expressed in days between scans.

scan_scope.title: Scan Scope Coverage
scan_scope.description: The coverage scope of the configured scan, indicating which portions of the filesystem are included.

event_logging_enabled.title: Detection Event Logging Enabled
event_logging_enabled.description: Indicates whether the antimalware solution is configured to generate and persist structured audit logs for detection, quarantine, and remediation events.

real_time_alerting_enabled.title: Real-Time Alerting Enabled
real_time_alerting_enabled.description: Indicates whether the antimalware solution is configured to send real-time alerts to a SOC platform (e.g., SIEM, SOAR, or ticketing system) upon detection, quarantine, or remediation events.

log_destination.title: Log Destination
log_destination.description: The destination to which detection event logs are forwarded for SOC visibility and compliance reporting.

logged_event_types.title: Logged Event Types
logged_event_types.description: List of event categories that the antimalware solution is configured to log (e.g., detection, quarantine, remediation, policy_change).

automatic_updates_enabled.title: Automatic Signature Updates Enabled
automatic_updates_enabled.description: Whether the antimalware solution is configured to automatically download and apply signature/definition updates without manual intervention.

signature_update_interval_hours.title: Signature Update Interval (Hours)
signature_update_interval_hours.description: The configured frequency at which the antimalware solution checks for and applies new signature/definition updates, expressed in hours.

hours_since_last_successful_update.title: Hours Since Last Successful Signature Update
hours_since_last_successful_update.description: The number of hours elapsed since the antimalware engine last successfully downloaded and applied a signature/definition update.

update_infrastructure_reachable.title: Update Infrastructure Reachable
update_infrastructure_reachable.description: Indicates whether the endpoint can successfully reach the antimalware vendor's update servers or an internal update relay/proxy.

management_console_connected.title: Management Console Connected
management_console_connected.description: Indicates whether the endpoint agent is actively connected to and checking in with the central management console.

policy_compliance_status.title: Policy Compliance Status
policy_compliance_status.description: The current policy compliance state of the endpoint as reported by the central management console.

agent_check_in_interval_minutes.title: Agent Check-In Interval (Minutes)
agent_check_in_interval_minutes.description: The number of minutes since the endpoint agent last successfully checked in with the central management console.

network_scanning_enabled.title: Network Traffic Scanning Enabled
network_scanning_enabled.description: Indicates whether real-time scanning of files transferred over network protocols (HTTP, FTP, SMB, etc.) is active.

download_scanning_enabled.title: Browser Download Scanning Enabled
download_scanning_enabled.description: Indicates whether files downloaded through browsers and download managers are scanned before being written to the filesystem.

scan_engine_mode.title: Scan Engine Analysis Mode
scan_engine_mode.description: The analysis methods employed by the scanning engine for network and download inspection.

exclusion_list_reviewed.title: Exclusion List Recently Reviewed
exclusion_list_reviewed.description: Whether the antimalware exclusion list has been reviewed and validated within the required audit period.

wildcard_exclusion_count.title: Wildcard Exclusion Count
wildcard_exclusion_count.description: Number of exclusion entries using broad wildcards (e.g., *, ?) that cover large portions of the filesystem or process space.

exclusion_scope.title: Exclusion Scope Breadth
exclusion_scope.description: Broadest scope level present in the current exclusion list, indicating how wide the coverage gaps may be.

exclusions_business_justified.title: All Exclusions Have Business Justification
exclusions_business_justified.description: Whether every entry in the exclusion list has a documented, approved business justification tied to a specific application or operational requirement.
